panel_inspected: J (Ptch1 RNAscope on tdTomato+ clones), K (per-cell quantification); A-I are H&E, Safranin-O and tdTomato lineage tracing
what_is_visible: Panels A-I show control versus Ptch1 cKO morphology and traced clones - mutant phenotype, not expression. Panel J is the only Ptch1 expression image: cyan RNAscope puncta scattered sparsely among red tdTomato+ columnar chondrocytes. The field is cropped to the traced clone; no full growth plate is shown, so resting-versus-hypertrophic comparison is not in frame.
adjacent_zone_signal: not assessable - only the traced clone is in frame
controls_visible: genotype controls (WT, cHet, cKO) present; no probe negative control visible
expression_or_morphology: mixed: one expression panel inside a mutant-morphology figure
revised_call: sparse punctate chondrocytic signal within traced columns; no zonal map
changes_stage42: YES - stage 42 called this RESTING_ZONE via body text about PTHrP+ resting cells. The image does not show a zonal Ptch1 distribution at all.

panel_inspected: L, M (RUNX2 immunofluorescence, tibial growth plate), T (integrated density by region)
what_is_visible: Red RUNX2 signal is genuinely graded along the plate: weak in the columnar zone, stronger in the hypertrophic zone, strongest in the primary spongiosa immediately below - i.e. the brightest compartment is bone, not cartilage. Panels A-K are H&E morphometry of the Runx2-GFP allele.
adjacent_zone_signal: columnar zone clearly lower but not absent
controls_visible: WT versus Runx2GFP/GFP genotype pair; no isotype or secondary-only control visible
expression_or_morphology: expression (L, M) within a figure whose other panels are mutant morphology
revised_call: hypertrophic-to-osteoblastic gradient; the peak is osteoblastic
changes_stage42: PARTLY - the hypertrophic call survives but is confounded by a stronger osteoblastic signal directly beneath, which stage 42's contamination test flagged and the image confirms.

panel_inspected: A-C (SOX9 immunofluorescence, cyan, E13.5 limb), E, F (Sox9-creER tdTomato lineage at P21 and 3 months)
what_is_visible: The only SOX9 expression panels are embryonic (E13.5) and show broad cyan staining across the whole cartilage anlage with no zonal architecture - at that stage there is no growth plate. Panels E and F are lineage tracing: red marks descendants of Sox9-expressing cells and covers cartilage, perichondrium, periosteum and marrow vasculature. That is fate, not expression.
adjacent_zone_signal: no zones exist at the stage where expression is shown
controls_visible: quantified per compartment in panel D; no antibody negative control visible
revised_call: broad chondrocytic expression in embryonic anlage; postnatal signal is lineage, not expression
changes_stage42: YES - stage 42's PERICHONDRIAL top zone came from lineage-tracing captions. Lineage labelling of the perichondrium does not mean SOX9 is expressed there now.

panel_inspected: D (Foxc1 dark-field ISH, 16.5 dpc), G-I (high magnification of boxed regions)
what_is_visible: Red Foxc1 signal forms a thin continuous rim around the outside of the cartilage element and extends into surrounding mesenchyme. The cartilage core is dark. High-magnification panels G-I confirm the signal sits at the perichondrial surface, not in the chondrocyte columns. All panels are embryonic (12.5-16.5 dpc).
controls_visible: Foxc2 shown in parallel channel; no sense-probe control visible
revised_call: perichondrial and peri-skeletal mesenchyme, embryonic only
changes_stage42: YES - stage 42 called Foxc1 hypertrophic. The image shows perichondrium, and at an embryonic stage with no postnatal growth-plate zonal architecture.

panel_inspected: b (TSC2 immunofluorescence, green, with IgG isotype control panel); a is a western blot
what_is_visible: Green TSC2 signal is present across the columnar chondrocytes in the field, somewhat stronger toward the lower (maturing) edge. The field is cropped to columns only - resting and terminal hypertrophic zones are outside the frame, so no zonal comparison is possible. An IgG isotype control panel is shown and is clean.
controls_visible: IgG isotype control visible and negative - the best control in the whole audit
revised_call: broadly chondrocytic across the columnar field; zone not determinable
changes_stage42: YES - stage 42's hypertrophic call cannot be supported by this figure, because the hypertrophic zone is not in the image.

panel_inspected: B, C (Jun-B immunostaining, red, with Pdgfra-GFP and PDGFRb); D-G are Junb-iDeltaMSC mutant phenotype
what_is_visible: The growth plate is labelled 'gp' and bounded by a dashed line at the top of panels B and D. All Jun-B-positive cells (arrowheads) lie BELOW that line, in the metaphyseal marrow among PDGFRb+ perivascular stromal cells. There is no Jun-B signal inside the growth plate.
revised_call: metaphyseal perivascular stroma, outside the growth plate entirely
changes_stage42: YES - Junb is not a growth-plate gene. Stage 42 had it UNRESOLVED with no zone; the image puts it outside the tissue.

panel_inspected: A-L (HDAC5 immunohistochemistry across ages in mandibular condyle)
what_is_visible: Sparse brown DAB signal concentrated in ring-shaped vascular or canal structures within the condylar tissue and subchondral bone; chondrocyte staining is faint to absent. The tissue is mandibular condylar cartilage - a secondary cartilage - not a long-bone growth plate.
image_quality: poor (646x328 for a 12-panel composite; individual panels are very small)
revised_call: vascular/canal-associated staining in condylar cartilage; wrong tissue
changes_stage42: YES - stage 42's hypertrophic call rests on a tissue that has no growth-plate zones.

panel_inspected: j-m (ACVR1 immunohistochemistry in heterotopic ossification lesions); a-i are microCT and skeletal preparations
what_is_visible: Brown ACVR1 staining covers ectopic cartilage, ectopic bone and adjacent muscle in a heterotopic ossification lesion from an Acvr1 R206H mouse. Staining is broad rather than compartment-restricted. No growth plate appears anywhere in the figure, and there is no normal-tissue comparator.
controls_visible: panel k appears to be a lower-signal region; no formal negative control labelled
revised_call: diffuse staining in ectopic HO cartilage and muscle; not growth plate
changes_stage42: YES - excluded under the brief's own rule: disease tissue with no normal comparator, and not a growth plate.

panel_inspected: a-c (BrdU immunohistochemistry in growth plate), f (Ezh2 qPCR by laser-captured zone)
what_is_visible: There is no Ezh2 image. Panels a-c stain BrdU, i.e. proliferation, in WT and Ezh2 mutant plates. The zonal Ezh2 information is panel f, a qPCR series on laser-captured resting, proliferative and hypertrophic zones showing Ezh2 highest in the resting zone and declining. That is zone-resolved but it is not an image.
controls_visible: IgG control shown for the ChIP panel (g), not for any imaging
revised_call: no imaging evidence; laser-capture qPCR suggests resting-zone enrichment
changes_stage42: NO CHANGE - already LEVEL_D. The qPCR observation is recorded but is not spatial evidence.

panel_inspected: L (BRD4 immunohistochemistry, sham versus ovariectomised trabecular bone); the rest are heatmaps, violin plots, western and microCT
what_is_visible: The only stained tissue is adult trabecular bone and marrow from an osteoporosis model. There is no growth plate in the figure. Brown BRD4 signal is in marrow and bone-surface cells.
revised_call: adult marrow and bone surface; wrong tissue and wrong age
changes_stage42: NO CHANGE - already LEVEL_D, and the image confirms there is no growth-plate content.

panel_inspected: E (Itgb1 split violin plots, WT versus Aga2); C and D image Col1a1 and type I collagen, not Itgb1
what_is_visible: There is no image of Itgb1 in any tissue. The Itgb1 content is entirely split violin plots from dissociated single-cell data. The tissue panels show a different gene.
revised_call: no intact-tissue evidence for Itgb1 exists in this figure
changes_stage42: NO CHANGE - already LEVEL_D; the image confirms the record should never have entered the corpus as intact-tissue evidence.

panel_inspected: A, G (Villanueva-stained sections, Agrp-Cre versus Agrp-Pdk1-/-); E (calcein double label)
what_is_visible: No AGRP staining appears anywhere. The figure is bone histomorphometry comparing an Agrp-Cre control with an Agrp-Cre-driven Pdk1 deletion. Agrp is present only as the name of the Cre driver, and the deleted gene is Pdk1.
revised_call: no Agrp localization of any kind
